name: HEXIND
recent: Hextar Industries 以 RM177.48 million 收购 Woodpeckers Group 51% 股权的计划，因先决条件未能在期限内达成，已于 2026 年 9 月 11 日失效。公司近期也持续在公开市场回购股份。最新季度营收为 RM357.3 million，净利 RM13.0 million。
notable: 拟以 RM177.48 million 现金收购 Woodpeckers Group 51% 股权的计划，因先决条件未达成而失效。
公司于 2026 年 8 月多次在公开市场回购股份。
risks: Woodpeckers 收购告吹，相关 llaollao 交易也据报终止。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM357.3 million，环比增长 52.2%，同比增长 27.2%；净利为 RM13.0 million，同比增长 95.6%，净利率 3.6%，较上一季度的 -2.8% 转正。

recent_en: Hextar Industries' proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Woodpeckers Group for RM177.48 million lapsed on 11 September 2026 after conditions precedent were not fulfilled. The company has also been buying back shares on the open market. Latest quarterly revenue was RM357.3 million with net profit of RM13.0 million.
notable_en: The proposed cash acquisition of a 51% stake in Woodpeckers Group for RM177.48 million lapsed as conditions precedent were not fulfilled.
The company made multiple open-market share buybacks in August 2026.
risks_en: The Woodpeckers acquisition fell through, and the related llaollao deal was reportedly terminated.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM357.3 million, up 52.2% QoQ and 27.2% YoY; net profit was RM13.0 million, up 95.6% YoY, with a net margin of 3.6% versus -2.8% in the prior quarter.
